gems.needs: expert gem lists (lists that claim their units are good and overlooked, with at least 90% low-popularity units), or your own picks of low-popularity units

low_rule.rule: no chart, award or hit list, no cover or reuse, no article, and outside the top 10% of each count (releases: never popular at 2 or fewer)

models.label: Provisional: expert word, else lead
models.about: A placeholder until gemness has its own model. Expert word: how strongly expert gem lists (or your own picks) single the unit out, whatever its popularity. Lead: a 'worth a listen' hint (a strong team, a hit beside it) with no expert word yet; leads are not gems. Units with neither are unrated, not zero.
